name: Very Merrytime Potted Chicken Liver Parfait with Apricot-Date Compote & Brioche
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Whipped chicken liver parfait on warm toasted brioche is completely smooth and seedless, though rich in butterfat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread a modest amount of the smooth parfait onto the toasted brioche and skip the fibrous dried date pieces in the compote.
watchOuts: High butterfat in the potted liver mousse
Fibrous dried date skins in the compote
